name: Kai Joris Sakura
original_name: カイ ジョリス 佐倉
source:
2nd year high school student.
Belonging to a family of artists, he's the only one that shows talent in magical studies. He's a man of a few words, but when he does speak, his comments are as sounds pompous. Courteous and nice to women, his gentlemanliness makes him popular with them. He excels in summoning magic.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
